d:
Bhide complains to Jethalal that the cheap phone he bought from Gada Electronics stopped working in just one day. While Jethalal insists it came with no warranty, Daya steps in and convinces him to give Bhide a branded, packaged replacement (deducting the earlier amount).
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
